mainTopic: The end of the story of רבי יהושע בן חנניה and זקני אתונא; the משנה on doubtful firstborn donkeys (פטר חמור); and whether that משנה can follow רבי יוסי הגלילי
overview: This amud has three parts. First, the גמרא finishes the story of רבי יהושע בן חנניה and זקני אתונא. He brings them before the קיסר, proves who they are with their home soil, and defeats them with water from a place in the sea that swallows everything. Then a new משנה teaches how פטר חמור works when twins are born, or when two donkeys give birth together and we do not know which baby came first. The כהן gets a lamb only for a male that is certainly a בכור. In a doubtful case, the owner sets aside a lamb and keeps it, because המוציא מחבירו עליו הראיה. The משנה also teaches that any sheep or goat may be used for the redemption, and that a lamb the owner keeps is ordinary חולין. Finally, the גמרא asks whose view the משנה follows. רבי ירמיה says it is not רבי יוסי הגלילי, who holds that twins can be born at exactly the same moment. אביי tries to fit it to him anyway, but a ברייתא shows that רבי יוסי הגלילי gives both twin donkeys to the כהן, so אביי is refuted.

steps.title: The jug of water and the doubtful captives before the emperor
steps.stepSummary: On the way back, רבי יהושע בן חנניה fills a jug from the 'House of the Swallowed.' He presents זקני אתונא to the קיסר, but the קיסר does not believe these weak men are really them.
steps.simpleTranslation: When they reached the 'House of the Swallowed,' he filled a jug of water from there. When they arrived, he stood them before the emperor. The emperor saw that they were suffering and humbled. He said: These are not them!
steps.whatsHappening: The story continues. רבי יהושע collects some special water for later, and the קיסר doubts that these broken captives are the famous wise men of Athens.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The 'House of the Swallowed' is a spot in the sea where the water swallows up everything near it. The jug he fills here is set up now so that it can be used at the end of the story. The קיסר expected proud, strong scholars, so seeing them weak and suffering made him doubt.

keyTerms.meaning: 'House of the Swallowed': a place in the sea that sucks in everything
A small jug
The emperor (Caesar)
Suffering, humbled, weakened

phrases.english: When they reached the House of the Swallowed,
he filled a jug of water from the House of the Swallowed.
phrases.notes: He is preparing for the final trick.

phrases.english: When they arrived, he stood them before the emperor.
He saw that they were suffering,
he said to him: These are not them.
phrases.notes: The real Athenian scholars were known as proud and strong.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues the story of רבי יהושע בן חנניה and זקני אתונא from the previous section of the daf.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The קיסר doubts that the humbled captives are זקני אתונא.

steps.title: The Athenian soil brings back their arrogance
steps.stepSummary: רבי יהושע throws some of their own Athenian soil on them. They become arrogant again in front of the king, and the קיסר gives רבי יהושע permission to do with them as he wishes.
steps.simpleTranslation: He took some of their soil and threw it on them. They became brazen before the king. The king said to him: Do with them whatever you want.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי יהושע proves that these really are the wise men of Athens. Once they smell their home soil, their old arrogance comes back.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Earlier in the story רבי יהושע had brought dirt from Athens. Being near their home soil restored their old pride, so they spoke rudely before the king. That proved who they were, and the king handed them over to רבי יהושע.

keyTerms.meaning: Their dirt / soil (from their homeland)
They acted hard / brazen, arrogant
Before the face of the king

phrases.english: He took some of their soil
phrases.notes: Soil from Athens that he had brought along.

phrases.english: and threw it upon them,
they acted brazenly before the king.

phrases.aramaic: אֲמַר לֵיהּ: כֹּל דְּבָעֵית עֲבֵיד בְּהוּ.
phrases.english: He said to him: Do with them whatever you want.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the קיסר's doubt from step 1 by showing their true nature.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Their identity is proven, and the קיסר hands them over to רבי יהושע.

steps.title: The swallowing water defeats the Athenian elders
steps.stepSummary: רבי יהושע pours the swallowing water into a vessel and tells them they may go once they fill it. They keep pouring, but the vessel swallows everything, until their shoulders give out and they are finished.
steps.simpleTranslation: He brought the water he had taken from the House of the Swallowed and poured it into a vessel. He said to them: Fill it up, and then you may go. They filled and poured in, one after another, and it swallowed it all. They filled until their shoulders came out of joint. They were worn out, and they were gone.
steps.whatsHappening: This is the end of the story. The jug of water from step 1 is now used to defeat זקני אתונא for good.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Because the water came from a place that swallows everything, the vessel could never be filled. The scholars were given an impossible task and worked until they collapsed. Their arrogance led to their downfall.

keyTerms.meaning: A vessel / container
One after another, again and again
Their shoulders were dislocated
They were worn out / swallowed up, i.e., defeated

steps.whatToRemember: The whole story shows רבי יהושע בן חנניה defeating זקני אתונא through wisdom. The water from בי בליעי, collected earlier, is the final tool of their defeat.

phrases.english: He brought the water
that he had brought from the House of the Swallowed,
he poured it into a vessel,

phrases.aramaic: אֲמַר לְהוּ: מַלְיוּהּ לְהוּ וְאֵיזִילוּ לְכוּ.
phrases.english: he said to them: Fill it up and go on your way.
They filled and poured into it, one after another,
and it swallowed it up,
they kept filling until their shoulders were dislocated,
and they were worn out and gone.
phrases.notes: Meaning they were defeated, or according to some readings, that they perished.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Uses the permission granted in step 2 and the water from step 1 to end the story.
steps.maskanaFinalTakeaway: זקני אתונא are finally defeated by the vessel that could never be filled.

steps.title: One donkey giving birth to twins
steps.stepSummary: The new משנה: if a donkey that never gave birth has two males, one is certainly a בכור, so the owner gives one lamb to the כהן. If it has a male and a female, it is a ספק, so he sets aside a lamb but keeps it for himself.
steps.simpleTranslation: A donkey that had never given birth before gave birth to two males: the owner gives one lamb to the כהן. If it had a male and a female: he sets aside one lamb, and it stays his.
steps.whatsHappening: A new משנה begins about פטר חמור, the first-born male donkey, which must be redeemed with a lamb (שה) given to the כהן. It starts with the case of one donkey having twins.
steps.deeperAnalysis: With two males, one of them was surely born first and is a בכור, so the כהן definitely gets a lamb. With a male and a female, the female may have come out first, so the male might not be a בכור. He still sets aside a lamb to redeem the possible בכור, but he keeps it. That is because of the rule המוציא מחבירו עליו הראיה: the כהן wants to take money from the owner and cannot prove that the male was first.

keyTerms.meaning: Abbreviation for מַתְנִיתִין, the משנה
A female donkey
That had never given birth before (its first birth)
A lamb, used to redeem the פטר חמור
Sets aside / designates

steps.confusionAlert: 'מפריש טלה אחד לעצמו' does not mean the lamb is not needed. He must still set it aside to redeem the possibly holy donkey. The only point is that the lamb stays his property, because the כהן cannot prove his claim.
steps.whyThisMatters: This sets up the core principle of the whole משנה. The כהן only receives when the בכור is certain, but the owner still has to deal with the possible holiness of a doubtful בכור.

phrases.english: Mishnah:
A female donkey that had not given birth before
and gave birth to two males —
he gives one lamb to the priest,
phrases.notes: One of the two males is certainly the first-born.

phrases.english: a male and a female —
he sets aside one lamb for himself.
phrases.notes: It is a doubt, and the priest cannot prove the male came first.

steps.triggerLanguage: חֲמוֹרָה שֶׁלֹּא בִּיכְּרָה וְיָלְדָה שְׁנֵי זְכָרִים
steps.relationToPreviousStep: A new topic. The אגדה has ended and a new משנה begins.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: A certain בכור requires giving a lamb to the כהן. A doubtful one requires setting aside a lamb that the owner keeps.

steps.title: Two donkeys where a male is certainly first-born
steps.stepSummary: If two first-time donkeys give birth to two males, both are בכורות, so he gives two lambs. If they give birth to a male and a female, or two males and a female, at least one male is certainly a בכור, so he gives one lamb.
steps.simpleTranslation: His two donkeys that had never given birth gave birth to two males: he gives two lambs to the כהן. A male and a female, or two males and a female: he gives one lamb to the כהן.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה moves to a case of two donkeys giving birth at the same time. It lists cases where at least one male is definitely a בכור.
steps.deeperAnalysis: With two males, each donkey had one male, so both are בכורות and both need a lamb. With a male and a female, each donkey had one baby, so the male came alone to its mother and is surely a בכור. With two males and a female, we do not know how the babies were split. Either way, one male is certainly a בכור. If one mother had both males, one of them came first. If one mother had a single male, that male is a בכור. The second male might not be first, so exactly one lamb is certainly owed.

keyTerms.meaning: His two female donkeys
Lambs (plural of טָלֶה)
A female

phrases.english: His two donkeys that had not given birth before
and they gave birth to two males —
he gives two lambs to the priest.
phrases.notes: Each donkey bore one male, so both are certainly first-born.

phrases.english: A male and a female,
or two males and a female —
he gives one lamb to the priest.
phrases.notes: In either case one male is certainly a first-born: either it was born alone to its mother, or one mother bore both males and one of them came first.

steps.triggerLanguage: שְׁתֵּי חֲמוֹרָיו שֶׁלֹּא בִּיכְּרוּ וְיָלְדוּ שְׁנֵי זְכָרִים
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Expands the rule of step 4 from one donkey to two donkeys.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The כהן receives one lamb for each certain בכור.

steps.title: Two donkeys where no male is certainly first-born
steps.stepSummary: If they give birth to two females and a male, or two males and two females, every male might have been born after a female. So the כהן gets nothing.
steps.simpleTranslation: Two females and a male, or two males and two females: the כהן gets nothing.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה finishes with cases where no male is definitely a בכור, so the כהן receives nothing at all.
steps.deeperAnalysis: We do not know which donkey bore which offspring. With two females and a male, it is possible that one donkey had a female, and the other had a female and then the male; in that case the male was not first. With two males and two females, it is possible that each donkey had a female first and then a male. Since no male is certainly a בכור, the כהן cannot prove his claim and gets nothing.

keyTerms.meaning: Females
The כהן receives nothing

steps.whatToRemember: The rule of the משנה: count only the males that are certainly first-born; each one earns the כהן a lamb. Wherever a female might have come out first, the male is only a doubt, and the כהן gets nothing for him.
steps.confusionAlert: 'אין לכהן כלום' only means the כהן receives nothing. It does not say the doubtful males are fully ordinary. The משנה states this only about what the כהן receives.

phrases.english: Two females and a male,
or two males and two females —
the priest has nothing.
phrases.notes: Perhaps the females were born first in each case.

steps.triggerLanguage: שְׁתֵּי נְקֵבוֹת וְזָכָר, אוֹ שְׁנֵי זְכָרִים וּשְׁתֵּי נְקֵבוֹת
steps.relationToPreviousStep: The opposite of step 5: cases where no male is certainly a בכור.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: When every male is only a doubtful בכור, the כהן receives nothing.

steps.title: One experienced donkey and one first-time donkey give birth
steps.stepSummary: One donkey has given birth before and one has not. If they produce two males, the owner gives one lamb to the כהן. If they produce a male and a female, he sets aside a lamb for himself.
steps.simpleTranslation: If one donkey had already given birth and one had not, and they gave birth to two males, he gives one lamb to the כהן. If they gave birth to a male and a female, he sets aside one lamb for himself.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה gives its last twin case. Only one of the two mothers is a first-time mother.
steps.deeperAnalysis: With two males, one of them must have come from the first-time donkey, so one בכור is certain and the כהן gets a lamb. With a male and a female, the male may have come from the donkey that already gave birth. Because it is only a doubt, the כהן cannot claim it.

keyTerms.meaning: She has already given birth (she already had her firstborn)
She has never given birth before
A lamb or kid used to redeem the firstborn donkey
He sets aside the lamb but keeps it for himself

steps.confusionAlert: Only the first-time mother can produce a בכור. The donkey that already gave birth never can, so the question is always whether the male came from the first-time mother.

phrases.english: One had given birth before, and one had not given birth before,
and they gave birth to two males —
he gives one lamb to the priest;
phrases.notes: One of the males surely came from the first-time donkey.

phrases.english: a male and a female —
he sets aside one lamb for himself.
phrases.notes: It is a doubt, and the one who wants to take property from another must bring proof.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues the list of twin cases in the משנה.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Two males: one lamb goes to the כהן. Male and female: the lamb is set aside and kept by the owner.

steps.title: The verse and which animals can be used for redemption
steps.stepSummary: The פסוק requires redeeming a firstborn donkey with a שה. The משנה lists the wide range of animals that qualify, and says one lamb can be used many times.
steps.simpleTranslation: As it says, 'And the firstborn of a donkey you shall redeem with a שה.' It can be from sheep or from goats, male or female, big or small, unblemished or blemished. One can redeem with it many times.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה gives the source for redeeming with a lamb. It then explains how broad the word שה is.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The word שה covers both sheep and goats and any age, gender, or physical condition. If the כהן gives the lamb back to the owner, the same lamb can be used again to redeem other firstborn donkeys.

keyTerms.meaning: The firstborn male of a donkey
A young sheep or goat
Unblemished
Blemished

phrases.english: As it is stated: "And the firstborn of a donkey you shall redeem with a lamb,"
from the sheep or from the goats,
male or female, old or young,
unblemished or blemished,
he may redeem with it many times,
phrases.notes: For example, when the כהן returns it to him.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives the scriptural source for the lamb mentioned in all the cases.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Any sheep or goat can be used: male or female, old or young, blemished or unblemished. It can be reused.

steps.title: The lamb kept by the owner is fully ordinary
steps.stepSummary: A lamb set aside in a doubtful case and kept by the owner has no holiness. It is tithed like his other animals, and he may benefit from it if it dies.
steps.simpleTranslation: It goes into the pen to be tithed, and if it dies, one may benefit from it.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה explains the status of the lamb the owner keeps for himself in the doubtful cases.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Setting the lamb aside does not make it holy. It stays regular חולין: it is counted with his flock for מעשר בהמה, and its carcass may be used.

keyTerms.meaning: Animal pen
To be tithed (מעשר בהמה)
One may benefit from it

steps.whatToRemember: In a doubtful case the owner sets aside a lamb, but it stays fully his and fully ordinary.

phrases.english: it enters the pen to be tithed,
phrases.notes: This refers to the lamb kept for himself.

phrases.english: and if it dies — one may benefit from it.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Defines the status of the lamb that was 'set aside for himself' in step 7.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The kept lamb is חולין: it is subject to tithing, and benefit from it is permitted.

steps.title: Who wrote this rule of the משנה?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks which תנא taught the rule that twin males from a first-time donkey get only one lamb.
steps.simpleTranslation: גמרא: Who is the תנא?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא opens by asking whose opinion stands behind the משנה. This sets up the answer in the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The question is aimed at the case of two males from a first-time donkey (step 4). The משנה gives only one lamb there, which assumes only one of the twins can be the בכור.

keyTerms.meaning: Who is the תנא (whose opinion is this)?

phrases.english: GEMARA: Who is the tanna?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Begins the גמרא on the משנה.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Which תנא holds that twin males produce only one בכור?

steps.title: רבי ירמיה: not רבי יוסי הגלילי
steps.stepSummary: רבי ירמיה says the משנה does not follow רבי יוסי הגלילי. He holds that two births can happen at exactly the same moment, so he would give two lambs.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי ירמיה said: It is not like רבי יוסי הגלילי. If it were רבי יוסי הגלילי, he says it is possible to be exact!
steps.whatsHappening: רבי ירמיה answers the question by ruling out one opinion.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי יוסי הגלילי says twins can come out at precisely the same instant, which would make both of them בכורות. The משנה gives only one lamb, so it must follow the חכמים, who say exact timing is impossible.

keyTerms.meaning: It is possible for two events to happen at precisely the same moment
A תנא who holds that exact timing is possible

phrases.english: Rabbi Yirmeya said:
It is not according to Rabbi Yosei HaGelili,
for if it were Rabbi Yosei HaGelili —
doesn't he say it is possible to be exact!
phrases.notes: See the later משנה on 17a about kosher twins whose heads emerged together.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר רַבִּי יִרְמְיָה: דְּלָא כְּרַבִּי יוֹסֵי הַגְּלִילִי
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the מאן תנא question.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: The משנה follows the חכמים, not רבי יוסי הגלילי, because he would hold both twins are בכורות.

steps.title: אביי: it can even be רבי יוסי הגלילי
steps.stepSummary: אביי says the משנה can match רבי יוסי הגלילי. His ruling about two firstborns is based on the plural word הזכרים, which is written about kosher animals.
steps.simpleTranslation: אביי said: You can even say it is רבי יוסי הגלילי. There it is different, because it is written 'הזכרים are for ה׳.'
steps.whatsHappening: אביי rejects רבי ירמיה's proof that the משנה cannot follow רבי יוסי הגלילי.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי יוסי הגלילי rules that both kosher twins are בכורות because of the plural word הזכרים ('the males') in the פסוק about kosher animals. No such plural is written about a firstborn donkey. So even he could agree that a donkey gets only one lamb.

keyTerms.meaning: You can even say
It is different there
'The males are for ה׳' (plural)

steps.whatToRemember: רבי ירמיה says the משנה follows the חכמים only. אביי says even רבי יוסי הגלילי could agree, because his rule about two firstborns comes from a פסוק about kosher animals.

phrases.english: Abaye said:
You can even say it is Rabbi Yosei HaGelili,
it is different there,
phrases.notes: 'There' means kosher animals.

phrases.english: for it is written: "The males are for the Lord."

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר אַבָּיֵי: אֲפִילּוּ תֵּימָא רַבִּי יוֹסֵי הַגְּלִילִי
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Pushes back on רבי ירמיה's exclusion of רבי יוסי הגלילי.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: Rejects the inference that the משנה cannot be רבי יוסי הגלילי.
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: רבי יוסי הגלילי's two-firstborn rule comes from a plural word written about kosher animals, not from logic alone, so it does not carry over to donkeys.

steps.title: Why not learn the donkey rule from kosher animals?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא challenges אביי: if רבי יוסי הגלילי gives two firstborns for kosher animals, why not apply the same rule to donkeys?
steps.simpleTranslation: But let us learn [the donkey rule] from it [the kosher-animal rule]!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא pushes back on אביי's answer. It asks why the donkey case cannot simply follow the kosher-animal case.
steps.deeperAnalysis: אביי said that רבי יוסי הגלילי gives two firstborns only because the word הזכרים is written about kosher animals. The challenge is that a firstborn donkey is also a kind of בכור, so it should share the same rule. If it did, the משנה (one lamb only) would again contradict רבי יוסי הגלילי.

keyTerms.meaning: Let us learn from it (copy the rule from the other case)
A firstborn donkey, which must be redeemed with a lamb

phrases.english: But let us derive [the donkey law] from it!
phrases.notes: From the rule of a firstborn kosher animal.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Attacks אביי's claim that the kosher-animal verse does not carry over to donkeys.
steps.kashyaTarget: אביי's limitation of רבי יוסי הגלילי's ruling to kosher animals
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: Both cases are firstborns, so a rule learned for one should naturally apply to the other.

steps.title: The Torah limited the rule with the word הזכרים
steps.stepSummary: The word הזכרים, with the definite article, restricts the two-firstborn rule to kosher animals.
steps.simpleTranslation: The Merciful One limited it with the word 'the males'.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the challenge. The תורה itself limited the two-firstborn rule to kosher animals.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The extra 'ה' in הזכרים means 'these specific males'. That teaches that only kosher-animal firstborns can count as two. So the donkey case cannot borrow the rule, and אביי's reading stands.

keyTerms.meaning: Excluded or limited (a verse narrowing a rule)
The Merciful One, meaning the תורה or ה׳
'The males' (שמות יג:יב), the word the rule is based on

steps.whatToRemember: According to אביי, רבי יוסי הגלילי's 'two firstborns' rule comes from a word that applies only to kosher animals. So a donkey's twins get just one lamb.

phrases.english: But the Merciful One excluded [it with the word] 'the males'.
phrases.notes: The definite article 'ה' limits the rule to kosher animals.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the challenge of step 13.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: Donkeys should follow the kosher-animal rule, since both are firstborns.
steps.terutzMaskana: The verse's wording limits the rule to kosher animals only.

steps.title: A second version: the משנה seems not to follow רבי יוסי הגלילי
steps.stepSummary: In a different version of the discussion, the גמרא suggests that the משנה does not follow רבי יוסי הגלילי, because he holds that births can be exactly simultaneous.
steps.simpleTranslation: Some say [the discussion went like this]: Shall we say [the משנה] is not like רבי יוסי הגלילי? Because if it were רבי יוסי הגלילי, he says it is possible to be exact [two births can happen at exactly the same time]!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a second way the same discussion was reported. In this version, the suggestion is raised as a 'shall we say' proposal, and it sets up אביי's answer in the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In the first version, רבי ירמיה stated outright that the משנה does not follow רבי יוסי הגלילי. Here the same idea is only put forward as a suggestion. The reasoning is the same: רבי יוסי הגלילי thinks twins can come out at exactly the same instant, so both could be firstborns and need two lambs.

keyTerms.meaning: Some say; introduces another version of the discussion
Shall we say; a suggestion the גמרא may later reject
It is possible to be exact (two events can happen at the same instant)

steps.confusionAlert: This is not a new argument. It is the same exchange from steps 11-12, reported in a slightly different form.

phrases.english: Some say:
phrases.notes: Introduces a second version of the discussion.

phrases.english: Shall we say it is not in accordance with Rabbi Yosei HaGelili,
for if it were Rabbi Yosei HaGelili —
doesn't he say it is possible to be exact [two births can be simultaneous]!

steps.triggerLanguage: אִיכָּא דְאָמְרִי: לֵימָא דְּלָא כְּרַבִּי יוֹסֵי הַגְּלִילִי
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Restarts the רבי ירמיה–אביי exchange in an alternate reported version.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Whether the משנה's one-lamb ruling can fit רבי יוסי הגלילי's view.

steps.title: אביי: it can still follow רבי יוסי הגלילי
steps.stepSummary: אביי rejects the suggestion. רבי יוסי הגלילי's view is different only in the kosher-animal case, because of the word הזכרים.
steps.simpleTranslation: אביי said: You can even say it follows רבי יוסי הגלילי. It is different there, because it is written 'the males shall be ה׳'s'.
steps.whatsHappening: אביי pushes away the suggestion from the previous step. He shows that the משנה can still fit רבי יוסי הגלילי.
steps.deeperAnalysis: אביי says the two-firstborn ruling depends on the verse הזכרים לה׳, which speaks about kosher animals. For donkeys, even רבי יוסי הגלילי would agree that only one lamb is given. So the משנה does not contradict him.

keyTerms.meaning: You can even say (introduces a defense)
It is different there

phrases.english: Abaye said:
You can even say it is Rabbi Yosei HaGelili,
it is different there,
phrases.notes: In the case of kosher animals.

phrases.english: for it is written: 'The males shall be the Lord's.'

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר אַבָּיֵי: אֲפִילּוּ תֵּימָא רַבִּי יוֹסֵי הַגְּלִילִי
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Rejects the 'shall we say' proposal of step 15.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: Rejects the claim that the משנה must go against רבי יוסי הגלילי.
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: It assumed רבי יוסי הגלילי's two-firstborn rule applies to donkeys, but it is based on a verse about kosher animals.

steps.title: Why doesn't the משנה say the heads came out together?
steps.stepSummary: Challenge to אביי: if the משנה follows רבי יוסי הגלילי, it should have stated the case of 'both heads emerged as one' to make its point clear.
steps.simpleTranslation: It works well according to רבי ירמיה, who does not explain the משנה like רבי יוסי הגלילי. That is why it does not say 'and both their heads came out as one'. But according to אביי, it should say 'and both their heads came out as one'!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא now attacks אביי's position from the wording of the משנה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: For רבי ירמיה, the משנה follows the חכמים, who think exact simultaneous birth is impossible, so there is no reason to mention it. For אביי, the משנה follows רבי יוסי הגלילי, who thinks simultaneous birth is possible. The משנה should then have taught the striking case of 'heads came out together, still only one lamb' to show its new point. Leaving it out fits רבי ירמיה better.

keyTerms.meaning: It works well (for one side), introducing a contrast
Sets it up, explains the source as following a certain view
Let it teach; the source should have said
Their heads together, at the same moment

phrases.english: It works well according to Rabbi Yirmeya,

phrases.aramaic: דְּלָא מוֹקֵי לַהּ כְּרַבִּי יוֹסֵי הַגְּלִילִי —
phrases.english: who does not establish it in accordance with Rabbi Yosei HaGelili —
that is why it does not teach:
'and both of their heads emerged as one,'
phrases.notes: Under the חכמים' view this cannot happen, so there is no reason to mention it.

phrases.english: but according to Abaye —
let it teach: 'and both of their heads emerged as one'!

steps.triggerLanguage: בִּשְׁלָמָא לְרַבִּי יִרְמְיָה, דְּלָא מוֹקֵי לַהּ כְּרַבִּי יוֹסֵי הַגְּלִילִי
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Compares the two positions and challenges אביי from the wording of the משנה.
steps.kashyaTarget: אביי's claim that the משנה follows רבי יוסי הגלילי
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: If the משנה followed רבי יוסי הגלילי, it would have mentioned simultaneous birth to show that even then only one lamb is given. Its silence suggests it follows the חכמים.

steps.title: A ברייתא: רבי יוסי הגלילי gives both donkeys to the כהן
steps.stepSummary: A further challenge to אביי: a ברייתא openly says that for twin donkeys whose heads came out together, רבי יוסי הגלילי gives both to the כהן.
steps.simpleTranslation: And more: it was taught in a ברייתא: If someone's donkey had never given birth before, and it gave birth to two males, and both their heads came out as one, רבי יוסי הגלילי says: both go to the כהן, as it says 'the males shall be ה׳'s'.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא adds a second, stronger challenge to אביי, this time quoting a ברייתא.
steps.deeperAnalysis: אביי claimed that רבי יוסי הגלילי gives two firstborns only for kosher animals. This ברייתא shows רבי יוסי הגלילי giving both twins to the כהן in the donkey case, using the same verse הזכרים לה׳. So it directly contradicts אביי and supports רבי ירמיה.

keyTerms.meaning: And furthermore; introduces an additional challenge
It was taught in a ברייתא
That had not given birth before (so this birth is a firstborn)

steps.whatToRemember: The ברייתא shows that רבי יוסי הגלילי applies 'two firstborns' even to donkeys. This strongly supports רבי ירמיה: the משנה (one lamb only) does not follow רבי יוסי הגלילי.
steps.whyThisMatters: It shows that the verse הזכרים is not limited to kosher animals in רבי יוסי הגלילי's view, which takes away אביי's main basis.

phrases.english: And furthermore, it is taught [in a baraita]:
His donkey that had not given birth before
and gave birth to two males,
and both of their heads emerged as one,
Rabbi Yosei HaGelili says:
both of them [go] to the priest,
as it is stated: 'The males shall be the Lord's.'

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Adds a second, explicit-source challenge to אביי after the wording challenge of step 17.
steps.kashyaTarget: אביי's claim that רבי יוסי הגלילי limits two firstborns to kosher animals
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: A ברייתא records רבי יוסי הגלילי applying the two-firstborn rule to donkeys, so the משנה's one-lamb ruling cannot follow him.
steps.raayaSupportSource: ברייתא about a first-time donkey bearing twin males

steps.title: The verse is about kosher animals, not donkeys
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks how the ברייתא can use "הזכרים לה׳" for donkeys, since that verse is written about a בכור with קדושת הגוף.
steps.simpleTranslation: But when this verse is written, it is written about an animal that has holiness in its body itself!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא raises a problem about the source behind רבי יוסי הגלילי's ruling for twin donkeys. The verse "הזכרים לה׳" speaks about a kosher בכור, so it seems it cannot be the direct source for a פטר חמור.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A kosher בכור has קדושת הגוף, meaning the animal itself becomes holy. A פטר חמור does not; it is only redeemed with a lamb. So the גמרא asks how a verse about one kind of holiness can directly decide a case about a different kind.

keyTerms.meaning: But surely. This opens a challenge.
Holiness of the body itself. The animal itself becomes holy, as with a kosher בכור.
It is written in the פסוק.

steps.confusionAlert: Do not think the גמרא is saying a פטר חמור is not a firstborn. It is still in the category of בכור. The point is only that its kind of holiness works differently from a kosher בכור.

phrases.english: But when this verse is written,
phrases.notes: "This verse" means "הזכרים לה׳".

phrases.english: it is written about inherent bodily sanctity!
phrases.notes: That is, about a kosher firstborn animal, not a donkey.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Questions the source behind the ברייתא quoted in Step 18 against אביי.
steps.kashyaTarget: The use of "הזכרים לה׳" as the reason for רבי יוסי הגלילי's ruling about twin donkeys.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The verse is about a kosher בכור with קדושת הגוף. A donkey has no קדושת הגוף, so the verse should not directly apply to it.

steps.title: The donkey rule is learned from the kosher-animal verse
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא answers that רבי יוסי הגלילי learns the donkey case from the verse "הזכרים לה׳" said about kosher animals.
steps.simpleTranslation: Rather, it is because it says "The males shall be the Lord's."
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא explains that רבי יוסי הגלילי takes the rule from the kosher-animal verse and applies it to donkeys as well. This answer also sets up the final blow against אביי.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Even though the verse speaks about kosher animals, רבי יוסי הגלילי extends its rule to the donkey. So for him, twins that come out together can both be firstborn in the donkey case too. That breaks אביי's claim that רבי יוסי הגלילי agreed to this only for kosher animals.

keyTerms.meaning: Rather. This introduces a new explanation.
As it is said, quoting a פסוק.
A firstborn donkey, which is redeemed with a lamb.

phrases.english: Rather, because it is stated
phrases.notes: About kosher animals, and from there applied to donkeys.

phrases.english: "The males shall be the Lord's,"
phrases.notes: Plural "males," so two can both be firstborn.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the question of Step 19.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Extension of a verse from kosher animals to a donkey
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The verse only covers animals with קדושת הגוף, so it cannot be the source for a donkey.
steps.terutzMaskana: רבי יוסי הגלילי learns the donkey law from the kosher-animal verse, so his view also covers donkeys.

steps.title: אביי is refuted
steps.stepSummary: Since רבי יוסי הגלילי applies the rule to donkeys too, אביי's distinction falls. The משנה does not follow רבי יוסי הגלילי.
steps.simpleTranslation: The refutation of אביי is a real refutation.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא declares that אביי's position has been fully refuted. This closes the discussion.
steps.deeperAnalysis: אביי had said רבי יוסי הגלילי's view applies only to kosher animals, because of the word הזכרים. The ברייתא shows he says the same about donkeys. So the משנה, which treats the donkey case differently, follows the רבנן and not רבי יוסי הגלילי.

keyTerms.meaning: A conclusive refutation. The opinion is rejected.

steps.whatToRemember: רבי יוסי הגלילי holds that two births can be exactly simultaneous, both for kosher animals and for donkeys. So the משנה, which does not accept that, follows the רבנן, and אביי's attempt to fit it to רבי יוסי הגלילי is refuted.
steps.whyThisMatters: It settles who the משנה follows: the רבנן, who hold that two births cannot be exactly simultaneous.

phrases.english: The refutation of Abaye is a conclusive refutation.
phrases.notes: Standard formula that closes the discussion against אביי.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Draws the final result from Step 20 against אביי's rejection in Step 16.
steps.maskanaFinalTakeaway: אביי is refuted. The משנה does not follow רבי יוסי הגלילי but the רבנן.
